CustomField.label: Usage by Model (JSON)
CustomField.description: Per-model token breakdown for this turn: [{model, stages, calls, tokensIn, tokensOut, cacheRead}]. A turn is not one model call — the router, a specialist subagent, and utility passes can each run on a different model. ModelUsed__c names only the model that produced the reply, so it cannot describe a multi-model turn; these entries sum back to TokensIn__c/TokensOut__c. Only populated on Role = Assistant.
